name: harnessgateway-chat-cdn-libraries
description: Not installed by anything: the manifest of the libraries the chat loads from its CDNs, pinned here so Dependabot proposes their updates. scripts/sync-cdn-libs writes these versions and fresh integrity hashes into static/rich.js and static/viewer.js; tests/unit/test_cdn_libs.py fails when they differ. SheetJS is not on npm (its npm package is years stale) and is bumped by hand in viewer.js.
